Name: Safety through Accountability and Recognition
Description:
Target: Supplier's OSHA Incidence Rate and Lost Time rate less than the national average by category
Purpose: Subaru is responsible to ensure that our Supply Base promotes the Safety of their workforce.
Frequency: Safety Results = Monthly
Kaizen = Biannual
Reporting: Report Safety data online monthly (2X per year for Kaizen).
Scoring: Score methodology: (OSHA IR below national average for industry = 2 points),  (OSHA Lost Time below national average for industry = 2 points),  (Kaizen = 1 point)

Name: Supplier Sustainability Performance
Description:
Target: Evaluate efforts to reduce landfill and energy consumption
Purpose: Subaru is responsible to ensure that our Supply Base protects our environment.
Frequency: Annual
Reporting: Annual survey return to SIA's Environmental Section
Scoring: Score methodology: (Participation = 1.5 points; Sustainability 2 points; Utility Reductions 1.5 points)

Name: PPM
Description:
Target: Less than 6 PPM for General; 0 PPM for Safety Vital
Purpose: Supplier must focus on why defects were made, why defects were shipped and what in the quality management system failed.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Based on both Vital and General part quality combined (defective Parts Per Million) as recorded in the Supplier Collaboration Portal
Scoring: PPM Vital and PPM General are a combined score

Name: PRC's Answered On Time
Description:
Target: 14 days allowed to answer on-time and must be 100% on time for all PRC issued
Purpose: Promote and encourage improved communication on performance issues with SIA, in order to have a good countermeasure urgently implemented.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Based on open time as recorded in the Supplier Collaboration Portal. Percentage of total PRC's answered on time.
Scoring: Score methodology: (100% = 5 points); (<100%, 0 points)
Any past due PRC from previous months will be counted against score.

Name: Changepoint Management
Description:
Target: Zero ECS PPAPs past due. ECS and PCR PPAPs approved prior to changepoint shipments
Purpose: Ensure changepoints are known, validated, and approved prior to shipment to SIA
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Based on PPAPs generated by drawing change (ECS) or Process Change Requests (PCRs)
Scoring: For ECS PPAPs only - Score methodology: (0 Past Due = 5 points); (1 = 4 points); (2 = 3 points); 
(3 = 2 points); (4 = 1 point); (>4 = 0 points)

For all changepoints needing authorization (ECS and PCR) - 5 points will be deducted for any shipments not officially authorized. For example - by PPAP or preauthorized AAS approval. (once per changepoint)

Name: Sorting Cost
Description:
Target: Zero Costs for sorts at SIA.
All sorting costs paid in a timely manner
Purpose: Continuous Improvement should be the goal of every Subaru supplier.  Both Quality and Costs should be continuously improved.  By improving processes and systems using the PDCA cycle, sort costs should be eliminated.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Total Sorting costs as reported by SIA third party sort company
Scoring: Score methodology: ($ = 0, 10 points); (>0, ≤$2k, 9 points); (>$2k,≤ $4k, 8 points); 
(>$4k,≤ $6k, 7 points); (>$6k,≤ $8k, 6 points); (>$8k,≤ $10k, 5 points); (>$8k,≤ $12k, 4 points);   (>$12k,≤ $14k, 3 points); (>$14k,≤ $16k, 2 points); (>$16k,≤ $18k, 1 point);(>$18k, 0 points)

If any sort costs are more than 60 days overdue, the score will be 0 regardless of the cost that month.

Name: Recall / Service Campaign
Description:
Target: Zero Recall or Service Campaign
Purpose: We must protect the customer at all times. If we have a Recall or Service Campaign, we put the customer at risk and cause damage to the Subaru brand reputation.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Based on Recall or Service Campaign as determined by market quality
Scoring: Requirement is zero recalls or service campaigns.  In the event of a recall or service campaign, 35 Points will be deducted in this category for 24 consecutive months.

Name: Supplier Monthly Warranty Analysis Reporting Summary
Description:
Target: 100%  Participation by due date
Purpose: More collaboration between Subaru and our supplier and all stages of the product life cycle can reduce the number and severity of warranty incidents.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: 100% Answered on time. 7 Days (168 hours) for monthly claim analysis.
Scoring: Score methodology:  (Accurate Warranty Claim Analysis = 2.5 points, Warranty Trend Charts Attachment = 2.5 points,  Late / No submission = 0 points)

Name: WCAR's Answered On Time
Description:
Target: 100% Answered on time
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Based on WCARs turned in on time as recorded by Quality Engineering Group. Score judged by percentage of completed WCARs answered on time.
Scoring: Score methodology: (100% on time = 5 points); (75% - 99% = 3 points);(1% - 74% = 1 point); 
(0% = 0 points)

Name: Height Cost Reduction
Description:
Target: Achieve provided targets by due date
Purpose: Missing targets affects the overall cost of the vehicle, which affects Subaru Customer's Satisfaction relating to vehicle cost.
Frequency: Biannual
Reporting: Results reported to SIA Procurement
Scoring: Score methodology: (100% of target = 20 points); (99.9% - 90% = 18 pts); (89.9% - 80% = 16 pts); (79.9% - 70% = 14 pts); (69.9% - 60% = 12 pts); (59.9% - 50% = 10 pts); (49.9% - 40% = 8 pts); (39.9% - 30% = 6 pts); (29.9% - 20% = 4 pts); (19.9% - 10% = 2 pt); (9.9% - 0.1% = 1 pt); (0% = 0 pts)

Name: Overall Cost Reduction Program Achievement
Description:
Target: Cost reduction progress towards meeting overall program targets
Purpose: Missing targets affects the overall cost of the vehicle, which affects Subaru Customer's Satisfaction relating to vehicle cost.
Frequency: Biannual
Reporting: Results reported to SIA Procurement
Scoring: Score methodology: (100% of target = 10 points); (99.9% - 90% = 9 pts); (89.9% - 80% = 8 pts); (79.9% - 70% = 7 pts); (69.9% - 60% = 6 pts); (59.9% - 50% = 5 pts); (49.9% - 40% = 4 pts); (39.9% - 30% = 3 pts); (29.9% - 20% = 2 pts); (19.9% - 10% = 1 pt); (9.9% - 0.1% = 0.5 pts); (0% = 0 pts)

Name: On Time Delivery of Production Parts
Description:
Target: 100% of parts are provided on time
Purpose: Late delivery of orders can and often do cause downtime of the SIA production lines.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Compare Actual Ship Date of Production Parts to Required Ship Date on ASN.  ASN inaccuracies also impact delivery percentage. Data pulled from ANTS.
Scoring: Delivery: (100%< x≤ 99%, 5 pts); (98%< x≤ 98.9%, 4 pts); (97%< x≤ 97.9%, 3 pts); 
(96%< x≤ 96.9%, 2 pts); (95%< x≤ 95.9%, 1 pts); (x < 95%, 0 pts)

Name: ASN Accuracy
Description:
Target: 100% of ASN's are accurate
Purpose: It is important to have visibility of what is incoming to SIA.  If ASN's are not accurate, it could impact production.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Validating the ASN information matches what is physically on the shipment.
Scoring: ASN Accuracy: (97%< x≤ 100%, 5 pts); (95%< x≤ 96.9%, 4 pts); (90%< x≤ 94.9%, 3 pts); 
(85% < x≤ 89.9%, 2 pts); (80%< x≤ 84.9%, 1 pts);  (x < 80%, 0 pts)

Name: Accurate Labeling of Production Parts
Description:
Target: 100% of parts are labeled correctly
Purpose: Inccorrectly labeled parts are a significant risk to SIA production.  Any mislabels are treated the same as a missed delivery.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Based on CANF reports from SIA Materials.
Scoring: Score methodology: (0 Mislabels = 5 points); (1 = 4 points); (2 = 3 points); (3 = 2 points); 
(4 = 1 point); (>4 = 0 points)

Name: CANF's Answered On Time
Description:
Target: All CANF's answered on time
Purpose: Promote and encourage improved communication on performance issues with SIA, in order to have a good countermeasure urgently implemented.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Corrective Action Notifications confirmed within 24 hours and if the 5 Why's, and the root cause analysis is not returned within the 3 day deadline points will deducted until the CANF is returned.
Scoring: Score methodology: (0 Past Due = 5 points); (1 = 4 points); (2 = 3 points); (3 = 2 points); 
(4 = 1 point); (>4 = 0 points)

Name: On Time Delivery of Service Parts
Description:
Target: 100% of parts are provided on time required
Purpose: Late delivery of service orders affects Subaru Customer's Satisfaction, which affects sales, which affect Subaru and Suppliers profitability.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Compare Actual Ship Date of Service Parts to Required Ship Date on ASN. Data pulled from ANTS.
Scoring: Score methodology: (On Time ≥ 95.0%, 10 points); (94%< x≤ 94.9%, 4 points); (93%< x≤ 93.9%, 3 points); (92%< x≤ 92.9%, 2 points); (91%< x≤ 91.9%, 1 point); (91%< x, 0 points)

Name: On Time Delivery of Prototype Parts
Description:
Target: 100% of parts provided on-time, labeled correctly with zero damages
Purpose: Late delivery, no mislabels, or defective parts for prototype orders affects Subaru Corp's ability to verify the quality of development vehicles, which could affect customer satisfaction of a new model purchase.
Frequency: Monthly
Reporting: Compare Actual Ship Date of Preproduction Parts to Required Ship Date on ASN. Data pulled from ANTS.  Damaged and no mislabels reported by freight forwarding company.
Scoring: On Time ASN (On Time 100% = 2 points, On Time <100.0% = 0 points), 
Damages (0 Damages = 2 points, >0 Damages = 0 points),
ANTS Labels (0 Missing Labels = 1 point, >0 Missing Labels = 0 points).

Name: Compliance: COO
Description:
Target: 100% COO compliance (2.5 points)
Purpose: To ensure that suppliers are submitting accurate information within the given timeframe.
Frequency: Bi-Annual
Reporting: Required documentation for COO Compliance submitted by deadline
Scoring: Score methodology: (On Time = 2.5 points); (Late / No submission = 0 points)

Name: Compliance: IMDS
Description:
Target: 100% IMDS compliance (2.5 points)
Frequency: Annual
Reporting: Required documentation for IMDS Compliance submitted by deadline
Scoring: Score methodology: (On Time = 2.5 points); (Late / No submission = 0 points)

Name: Downtime Occurrence
Description:
Target: Do not cause downtime at SIA
Purpose: Downtime at SIA is costly and greatly impacts production plans
Frequency: Monthy
Reporting: Internal SIA investigation
Scoring: Requirement is no downtime.  Score methodology: (No downtime = Blank score); 
(2-4 Hours = -10 points for 3 months); (4+ Hours = -20 points for 3 months)
